items.title: Announcing custom execution roles for AWS CloudFormation StackSets
items.summary: AWS CloudFormation StackSets now supports custom execution role templates, so you can define the IAM role StackSets uses in each member account instead of the default AdministratorAccess role. Scope permissions to least privilege, and deploy service-managed stack sets that use nested stacks, macros, and transforms.
items.creator: Tanvi Ravindra Malali

items.title: Track AWS CloudFormation StackSets deployments with progress visibility
items.summary: AWS CloudFormation StackSets now adds deployment progress visibility, a stage-by-stage view of where each stack set operation stands. See how much work is complete and which accounts and stack instances need attention, and follow a deployment while it runs across tens or thousands of accounts.
items.creator: Idriss Laouali Abdou
